unresolved_should_improve.claim: The revision cuts Tommy's request for tips. It also cuts Carter's 'imagination and an open mind... Don't be discouraged', the 'For one thing' connective, 'I hope it will myself', and 'needn't be cast down if you fail'. Carter now slides from fate straight to 'My experts have failed.' The forced-pace line reads as a bare threat rather than one reason not to despair, and Carter's own hope that haste will hurt the enemy is lost.
unresolved_should_improve.counterevidence: The essential new-year coup, the strike legislation and 'haven't much time' all survive in revision paragraph 5.

we're taking up an awful lot of your time. Have you any tips to give us before we clear out?
